title: A Minute for my Kidneys
official: A Minute for my Kidneys - Stadium V
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of the "One Minute for My Kidneys" program in reducing the time it takes for participants with stage V chronic kidney disease and other comorbidities to begin dialysis.
sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
